features.description: Base steel plate, 11.00 x 5.25 x nominal .105 thick. BOM item 1, quantity 1, 1018 steel, 12 gauge. Use lower-left corner of the broad face as the in-plane coordinate origin.
Through-thickness semicircular notch opening at the upper edge, diameter 3.062. Nominal center (5.500, 5.250) in the broad-face coordinate system.
Four .218 drilled through holes in a rectangular 10.500 x 4.500 center pattern. Construct using the four explicit centers in H001; cut through the steel plate.

Separate sponge-rubber strip body on the underside along the left side: 5.25 long x 1/2 wide x 5/32 thick, adhesive backed. Edge-flush placement is depicted but not separately dimensioned. BOM item 2, McMaster-Carr #1117A11 or equivalent.

Second separate sponge-rubber strip body on the underside along the right side, same dimensions and material as F004. Edge-flush placement is depicted but not separately dimensioned. Do not merge the rubber bodies into the steel body.

dimension_chains.description: Plate width = left hole margin + column spacing + derived right margin: 11 = .25 + 10.5 + .25.
Plate height = bottom hole margin + row spacing + derived top margin: 5.25 = .375 + 4.5 + .375.
Right hole column coordinate = left column coordinate + horizontal pitch.
Upper hole row coordinate = lower row coordinate + vertical pitch.
Notch center x = left hole-column offset + notch-center offset.
Total weather-strip material = two equal pieces: 10.5 = 5.25 + 5.25.
